headline: Election Commission Updates Draft Voter Rolls Across Indian States
metaDescription: Indian election authorities have updated draft electoral rolls, adding over 75 lakh names across 13 states and territories following recent verification.
aiSummaryBullets: Draft voter lists across 13 states and union territories show a recovery to nearly 46 crore voters after a prior reduction.
Uttar Pradesh has added 18 lakh voters to its rolls, reaching a total of 13.58 crore, amid political inquiries regarding list composition.
While Uttar Pradesh recorded the highest absolute increase in voters, Goa experienced the most significant growth in terms of percentage.
aiContextParagraph: The Election Commission of India has initiated the publication of draft Special Summary Revision (SSR) voter lists across multiple states. This process follows a period where the combined electorate in 13 states and union territories had decreased from 49.6 crore to 45.2 crore following a Special Integrated Revision (SIR). The recent draft updates show a recovery to approximately 46 crore voters. In Uttar Pradesh, the state's Chief Electoral Officer confirmed that 18 lakh new voters were added, bringing the total to 13.58 crore. This update has prompted political discourse, including questions from opposition figures regarding the status of various voter demographics, though the Election Commission maintains that it does not track voters based on religious affiliation. Similar updates and draft list releases have been reported in other regions, including Rajasthan, which saw an increase of 1.1 lakh voters compared to the previous SIR list.
whyItIsViral: The story is being tracked by two independent news outlets with a steady coverage velocity, indicating ongoing interest in electoral updates across the country.
